detail.readme:
**Your own one-person game studio.** Everything you need to make games with AI, in one app. **Make a game. Ship it everywhere. Earn from it.**

English · 简体中文

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/4d5805fe-92a2-40b4-a232-c7452f9a796a
> [!NOTE] > 🚧 OhMyGame is in beta. Expect rough edges. Join us and let's build it together! ## News - **2026-10 · beta 5** ([release notes](https://github.com/WhiteTowerAI/ohmygame/releases/tag/v0.0.0-beta.5.0)) - **Now with interactive stories:** make visual novels, interactive films, and story games. Every screen is a web page the agent builds from your description, with video, dialogue, choices, or even a mini-game, so your story isn't limited to fixed node types. - **Bring your own agent:** Claude Code, Codex, or OpenCode can run the conversation, or you can bring OhMyGame to them. - **Plugins:** build in Godot, Unity, Unreal Engine, or Cocos Creator; make assets in Blender, Aseprite, or Tiled; ship to WeChat Mini Games, Douyin Mini Games, or TapTap, and [earn from your game](#-publish-and-earn-one-link-or-the-platforms-where-players-pay). ## What it is Making a game takes design docs, 2D art, 3D models, video, code, and somewhere to put it when it's done. Today those live in five or six different tools. OhMyGame puts them in one app: describe your game, and the agent designs it, makes the assets, builds it, plays it to check it works, and publishes it to a link you can share. Two core design ideas shape it: 1. **Everything lives on a canvas.** Design docs, concept art, 3D models, and video sit side by side on one board. One character sketch can grow into more art, a video, or a rigged 3D model, and everything is ready to use in your game. 2. **The agent does the work.** It drives the canvas the way you would: drafting the design doc, turning a character sketch into a rigged 3D model, writing the code, and playtesting the result. It's open source and works with 40+ model providers through Pi, from Anthropic and OpenAI to DeepSeek and Qwen. Your keys stay on your machine, there are no per-run credits, and what you make is yours. ## Features ### 🤖 Agent: drives the canvas, builds and plays the game The agent works the canvas the way you would: it drafts the design doc, lays out boards, and generates assets on them. It reads the design doc, writes the code, and runs the game in a live preview. Then it opens the game in a window you can watch and plays it, including real-time canvas and WebGL games. When it finds a problem, it tries a fix and plays again. Along the way it can generate images, video, 3D models, and audio, search the web, and use MCP servers and plugins. **▶ The agent playtesting a new item feature on desktop and mobile, then reporting what it found (sped up 4×).** https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/3cb982e8-a4a8-4715-bf3c-df4e41e7855b ### 🎨 Canvas: design docs, art, video, 3D, and audio on one board Every game project has a design space: a main design doc plus boards where the doc, images, video, 3D models, and audio sit side by side. Nodes can use each other as references, so one character design can lead to more images, a video, a voice line, or a rigged and animated 3D model. Results go into a shared Asset Library that your games can use. https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/5a35964d-87b3-4153-8b1b-fc6deced5bb3 ### 🔗 Publish and earn: one link, or the platforms where players pay Sign in and publish: OhMyGame builds your game and gives it a link anyone can play in the browser. Republishing updates the same link. Published games are listed in the in-app Community, where you can play what others have made, sort by latest, most viewed, or most liked, visit creators' profiles, and like the games you enjoy. A one-person studio should pay for itself. Beyond the Community, plugins take your game to the platforms where players pay. | Ship to | Earn from | How | | --------------------------------------- | ------------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------- | | WeChat Mini Games, Douyin Mini Games | Ads, in-app purchases | [Platform plugins](#-plugins-connect-with-more-game-dev-tools) | | TapTap | Downloads, in-app purchases | TapTap Maker plugin | | Steam and other stores | Sales | Export from Godot or Unity with their plugins | | itch.io, Poki, CrazyGames | Sales, ad revenue share | Upload your Web Game build | **Your game, your revenue.** OhMyGame takes no cut of what your game earns. ### 🧑‍💻 Bring your own agent Already use Claude Code, Codex, or OpenCode? Choose it in the model picker and it runs the conversation with its own sign-in. It gets the whole studio: the canvas, media generation, playtesting, plugins, and Undo, with your history kept in OhMyGame. See [coding agents](docs/coding-agents.md). ### 🔌 Use OhMyGame from Claude Code, Codex, and other agents Already working in another coding agent? Turn on **Settings → MCP Server** and add OhMyGame to Claude Code or Codex with the command shown there. They get OhMyGame's media generation with your providers, the canvas, and playtesting, plus a Skill that explains the workflow. DeepSeek Harness and other MCP clients can add the `ohmygame-studio` command shown there. See [External agents](docs/external-agents.md). ### 🧩 Plugins: connect with more game dev tools Plugins let the agent work in the engines and tools you already know: - **Engines:** Godot, Unity, Unreal Engine, and Cocos Creator. - **Platforms:** TapTap Maker, WeChat Mini Games, and Douyin Mini Games. - **Assets:** Blender, Aseprite, and Tiled. Turn them on in **Plugins**, or build your own with Plugin Builder. Engine plugins use each engine's own editor and tools, so install those first. See [Plugins](docs/plugins.md). ## What you can make Three games our team made with OhMyGame:
Interactive film Island builder Deckbuilding roguelike
### 🎮 Web games **The best place to start.** 2D and 3D games for the browser, built with Three.js, React Three Fiber, or Phaser. The agent follows a complete web game workflow: a design doc, key-screen mockups, production art, a playable core loop, and playtesting in the live preview. Games fit any window size, support touch, and publish to a shareable link. The project is a normal web project you can open in any editor. ### 🎬 Interactive stories Interactive films, visual novels, and story games. Each screen is a free web page with its own images, video, and code: a main menu, a case archive, a dialogue, a puzzle. You connect them on a graph, and the runtime handles state, saves, music, and navigation. The story plays as its own web page, and the runtime is part of the project, so the agent can change anything about how it plays. The architecture and authoring model are documented in [Playable Nodes](docs/playable-nodes/README.md). ### 🎲 General games: any engine or stack **General Game** doesn't assume an engine or stack. Start from an idea, bring a project in any engine, or make tools and content for your game. The Game Studio plugin coordinates design, production art, implementation, and verification across engines, and the [engine plugins](#-plugins-connect-with-more-game-dev-tools) work in the engine you use. For Godot, start a **Godot** project from the sidebar. When the output is a web page, preview, playtesting, and publishing work as they do for Web games; native games use their engine's own tools. See [General Game details](docs/runtime.md#agent-game-use). **Making a browser game? Choose Web Game**: it is tuned for the browser. ## How it's built The idea that holds this together: one agent drives every part of the studio. **1 · A full Pi agent with a GUI.** OhMyGame runs [Pi](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent) with its full toolset and persistent sessions, in a GUI built for watching results rather than reading diffs. Close the app, come back, and the project, conversation, and context are still there. You describe, review, and steer; editing by hand is always possible, but it is not the main path. **2 · Every workspace is files.** A web game is a normal web project. A design doc is Markdown, and boards and the Asset Canvas share one JSON node model. An interactive story is a node graph on disk. Each comes with an `AGENTS.md` and JSON schemas, so the agent edits them the same way it edits code, and the visual editors read and write the same files. **3 · Games are tool calls.** Playing the game (`game_use`), generating media, and checking story nodes are ordinary Pi tools, next to its coding tools. That is why the agent can chain them: draft a design, make the art, write the code, and play the result in one conversation. ## Any model, your keys OhMyGame does not lock you into one model or charge per run. - **Coding models from 40+ providers** through Pi, including Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, DeepSeek, Qwen, Kimi, GLM, MiniMax, xAI, Mistral, Groq, OpenRouter, Amazon Bedrock, and Vercel AI Gateway. - **Sign in with a subscription you already have**, such as ChatGPT Plus/Pro or GitHub Copilot, or paste an API key. - **Coding agents you already use**: Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode run a conversation with their own sign-in, while OhMyGame keeps its history, Undo, canvas, media tools, and plugins. Enable them in Settings; native CLI permission limits apply. See [coding agents](docs/coding-agents.md). - **Media models** for images, video, 3D, and audio through OpenAI, Codex, OpenRouter, Volcengine Ark / BytePlus ModelArk, MiniMax, Meshy, Tripo, Hyper3D, and Doubao Speech / Seed Audio. - **Custom providers and model aliases** with selectable language, image, video and 3D uses, protocol templates and generation defaults. See [custom model configuration](docs/custom-models.md). Keys stay in the local daemon. They never reach the agent's workspace, your game, or the renderer. ## Quick start ### Download Grab the installer from the buttons at the top or from [Releases](https://github.com/WhiteTowerAI/ohmygame/releases). Builds are available for macOS (Apple silicon) and Windows (x64). The Windows build is not code-signed yet, so Windows may show a SmartScreen warning during install. See [the changelog](CHANGELOG.md) for changes in each release, or open **Settings → About → Changelog** inside the app. ### First run ![First-run AI connection screen](docs/assets/first-run-onboarding.png) OhMyGame ships without a model. On first launch, it walks you through setup: 1. **Get started.** Language and appearance follow your system; change them anytime in Settings. 2. **Choose your AI.** Use the built-in OhMyGame agent with a model provider (sign in or paste an API key), or a Claude Code, Codex, or OpenCode CLI you already have. Use **+** to add a custom or local endpoint. **Skip this step** moves on without a model. A language model alone can design and build a game. Generating media needs a corresponding provider, which you connect in **Settings → Providers**: | To make | Connect | | ----------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------- | | Design docs, code, playtests | Any language model provider | | Images and sprites | Codex CLI (local sign-in), OpenAI (API key), OpenRouter, or Volcengine Ark / BytePlus ModelArk | | Video | OpenRouter, Volcengine Ark / BytePlus ModelArk, or MiniMax | | 3D models, rigging, animation | Meshy, Tripo, or Hyper3D (capabilities vary by provider) | | Voice, sound effects, music | Doubao Speech and Seed Audio (Volcengine) | ChatGPT sign-in doesn't cover OpenAI's image API; add a separate API key in the OpenAI provider's **Image models** section. The **Codex CLI** image provider uses your local Codex sign-in instead. See [OpenAI image connections](docs/custom-models.md#openai-image-connections). 3. **Choose where to start:** describe a game in the prompt box on the home screen, start a blank project, or import a folder you already have. Web search works without setup. Making games locally needs no account; sign in only to publish. Reopen this setup from **Settings → About → View getting started**. ### Run from source Requires Bun 1.4.2 or newer for the toolchain and Node.js 22.19+ for the daemon. ```bash git clone --branch main https://github.com/WhiteTowerAI/ohmygame.git cd ohmygame bun install --frozen-lockfile bun run dev # web renderer + local daemon # or bun run dev:desktop # Electron app ``` This uses the release branch. For development contributions, start from `dev` using [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md#fork-and-create-a-branch). Local development can start without cloud configuration; see [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md#configuration) for optional integrations. ## Privacy Your projects and keys stay on your machine. Prompts and generation requests go directly to the model providers you choose. Publishing requires an OhMyGame account and uploads only your game's static build. Release builds check for updates and send usage data and crash reports. Usage data is linked to your account when you sign in, and you can turn it off in **Settings → About**. Builds from source send no telemetry. The desktop app keeps redacted logs on your machine; they leave it only if you export them from **Settings → About → Diagnostics** and share the file. See [logs and diagnostics](docs/diagnostics.md). ## Roadmap We're working on plain-language playtest reports, remixing games from the Community, and Intel Mac / Linux builds. See [Issues](https://github.com/WhiteTowerAI/ohmygame/issues) for what's next, and vote with 👍 on what matters to you. Want to help? Look for [`help wanted`](https://github.com/WhiteTowerAI/ohmygame/labels/help%20wanted) issues. ## Contributing Issues and PRs are welcome. Start contribution branches from `dev` and target ordinary PRs at `dev`; `main` receives releases. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for setup, checks, and review, [中文快速指引](docs/contributing.zh-CN.md) for a short Chinese introduction, and [the documentation index](docs/README.md) for module guides. Report security issues using [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md). ## Star History ## License [Apache-2.0](LICENSE). The OhMyGame name and logo are not covered by the license.
detail.readme_zh:
**你的一人游戏工作室。** 用 AI 做游戏需要的一切，都在一个应用里。使用你自己的模型密钥。 **做游戏，上架，赚钱。一个人就够了。**

English · 简体中文

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/4d5805fe-92a2-40b4-a232-c7452f9a796a
> [!NOTE] > 🚧 OhMyGame 目前处于 Beta 阶段，难免还有粗糙的地方。欢迎加入我们，一起把它做好！ ## 新动态 - **2026-10 · beta 5** （[更新说明](https://github.com/WhiteTowerAI/ohmygame/releases/tag/v0.0.0-beta.5.0)） - **现已支持互动故事：** 适合做视觉小说、互动电影和剧情游戏。每个画面都是一个自由的网页， 可以放视频、写对白、给选择，甚至装下一个小游戏；描述你想要的，Agent 就帮你做好， 不受固定节点类型的限制。 - **带上你自己的 Agent：** 用 Claude Code、Codex 或 OpenCode 来运行对话， 也可以把 OhMyGame 接进它们。 - **插件：** 在 Godot、Unity、Unreal Engine 或 Cocos Creator 里开发；用 Blender、 Aseprite 或 Tiled 做素材；上架微信小游戏、抖音小游戏或 TapTap， [让游戏帮你赚钱](#-发布和变现一个链接或者玩家付费的平台)。 ## 这是什么 做一款游戏，需要设计文档、2D 美术、3D 模型、视频、代码，做完还要有地方发布。 现在这些工作分散在五六个不同的工具里。OhMyGame 把它们放进了一个应用：描述你想做的游戏， Agent 会设计它、制作素材、搭建游戏、亲自试玩确认能正常运行，再发布成一个可以分享的链接。 它围绕两个核心设计理念： 1. **一切都在画布上。** 设计文档、概念图、3D 模型和视频并排放在同一块画板上。 一张角色草图可以延伸出更多美术图、一段视频，或者一个绑好骨骼的 3D 模型， 而且全部可以直接用在你的游戏里。 2. **活由 Agent 来干。** 它像你一样操作画布：起草设计文档，把角色草图变成绑好骨骼的 3D 模型，编写代码，再试玩检验结果。 OhMyGame 是开源的，通过 Pi 支持 40 多家模型服务商，从 Anthropic、OpenAI 到 DeepSeek、 通义千问。密钥留在你自己的电脑上，没有按次计费的点数，做出来的东西归你所有。 ## 功能 ### 🤖 Agent：操作画布，搭建并试玩游戏 Agent 像你一样使用画布：起草设计文档，排布画板，并在上面生成素材。它阅读设计文档、 编写代码，在实时预览中运行游戏。然后它会在一个你可以旁观的窗口里打开游戏并亲自试玩， 包括实时渲染的 Canvas 和 WebGL 游戏。发现问题时，它会尝试修复，然后再玩一遍。 在这个过程中，它还可以生成图片、视频、3D 模型和音频，搜索网络，并使用 MCP 服务器和插件。 **▶ Agent 在桌面端和移动端试玩一个新道具功能，然后汇报发现的问题（4 倍速）。** https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/3cb982e8-a4a8-4715-bf3c-df4e41e7855b ### 🎨 画布：设计文档、美术、视频、3D 和音频同在一块画板 每个游戏项目都有一个设计空间：一份主设计文档，加上若干画板，文档、图片、视频、3D 模型和音频 在画板上并排摆放。节点之间可以互相引用，所以一个角色设计可以衍生出更多图片、一段视频、 一句配音，或者一个绑好骨骼、带动画的 3D 模型。生成结果会进入共享的素材库（Asset Library）， 供你的游戏使用。 https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/5a35964d-87b3-4153-8b1b-fc6deced5bb3 ### 🔗 发布和变现：一个链接，或者玩家付费的平台 登录后即可发布：OhMyGame 会构建你的游戏，并生成一个任何人都能在浏览器里打开就玩的链接。 重新发布会更新同一个链接。发布的游戏会出现在应用内的社区（Community）里， 你可以在那里玩到别人做的游戏，按最新、最多浏览或最多点赞排序，查看创作者主页， 给喜欢的游戏点赞。 一人工作室，就该能养活自己。除了社区，插件还能把你的游戏送上玩家愿意付费的平台。 一个人做微信、抖音小游戏，靠广告和内购就能变现。 | 上架到 | 怎么赚钱 | 怎么做 | | -------------------------- | ------------------ | ------------------------------------------------- | | 微信小游戏、抖音小游戏 | 广告、内购 | [平台插件](#-插件连接更多游戏开发工具) | | TapTap | 下载、内购 | TapTap Maker 插件 | | Steam 等商店 | 买断 | 通过 Godot 或 Unity 插件导出 | | itch.io、Poki、CrazyGames | 付费下载、广告分成 | 直接上传网页游戏的构建产物 | **游戏是你的，收入也是你的。** OhMyGame 不从你的游戏收入里抽成。 ### 🧑‍💻 带上你自己的 Agent 已经在用 Claude Code、Codex 或 OpenCode？在模型选择器里选中它，它就会用自己的登录来运行对话， 并且能用上整个工作室：画布、媒体生成、试玩、插件和撤销，对话记录保留在 OhMyGame 里。 详见[编程智能体](docs/coding-agents.md)。 ### 🔌 在 Claude Code、Codex 等 Agent 中使用 OhMyGame 已经在用别的编程 Agent？打开 **设置 → MCP 服务**， 用那里显示的命令把 OhMyGame 添加到 Claude Code 或 Codex。它们会获得 OhMyGame 的媒体生成（使用你配置的服务商）、 画布和试玩能力，以及一个讲解工作流程的 Skill。DeepSeek Harness 和其他 MCP 客户端可以添加 那里显示的 `ohmygame-studio` 命令。详见 [External agents](docs/external-agents.md)。 ### 🧩 插件：连接更多游戏开发工具 插件让 Agent 在你熟悉的引擎和工具里干活： - **引擎：** Godot、Unity、Unreal Engine 和 Cocos Creator。 - **平台：** TapTap Maker、微信小游戏和抖音小游戏。 - **素材：** Blender、Aseprite 和 Tiled。 在 **插件** 页中启用，或者用插件构建器做你自己的插件。引擎插件使用各引擎自己的编辑器和工具， 请先安装好它们。详见 [Plugins](docs/plugins.md)。 ## 你可以做什么 我们团队用 OhMyGame 做的三款游戏：
互动电影 海岛建造 卡牌构筑 Roguelike
### 🎮 网页游戏 **最推荐的起点。** 运行在浏览器里的 2D 和 3D 游戏，使用 Three.js、React Three Fiber 或 Phaser 构建。 Agent 会走完一整套网页游戏流程：设计文档、关键画面 mockup、正式美术、可玩的核心循环， 以及在实时预览中试玩。做出来的游戏适配任意窗口尺寸，支持触屏，并能发布成一个可以分享的链接。 项目本身就是一个普通的 Web 项目，可以用任何编辑器打开。 ### 🎬 互动故事 互动电影、视觉小说和剧情游戏。每个画面都是一个自由的网页，拥有自己的图片、视频和代码： 主菜单、案件档案、一段对话、一个谜题。你在图上把它们连起来，运行时负责状态、存档、音乐和跳转。 故事作为独立的网页运行，运行时也是项目的一部分，所以 Agent 可以改动它运行方式的任何地方。 架构和创作模型见 [Playable Nodes](docs/playable-nodes/README.md)。 ### 🎲 General Game：任意引擎与技术栈 **General Game** 不预设引擎和技术栈。你可以从一个想法开始，导入用任何引擎做的项目， 或者为游戏制作工具和内容。Game Studio 插件负责在不同引擎之间协调设计、正式美术、开发实现和验证， [引擎插件](#-插件连接更多游戏开发工具)则让它在你所用的引擎里工作。做 Godot 游戏， 可以从侧栏新建一个 **Godot** 项目。 如果产出的是网页，预览、试玩和发布都和网页游戏一样可用；原生游戏使用各自引擎的工具。 详见 [General Game 说明](docs/runtime.md#agent-game-use)。**想做浏览器游戏？请选 Web Game**， 它专门为浏览器调优过。 ## 实现原理 把这一切串起来的思路是：一个 Agent 驱动工作室的每个部分。 **1 · 带图形界面的完整 Pi Agent。** OhMyGame 运行的是 [Pi](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent)，带有完整的工具集和持久化会话， 界面专为查看结果而设计，而不是让你读 diff。关掉应用再回来，项目、对话和上下文都还在。 你负责描述、审阅和把控方向；随时可以手动编辑，但那不是主要的用法。 **2 · 每个工作区都是文件。** 网页游戏就是一个普通的 Web 项目。设计文档是 Markdown， 画板和素材画布（Asset Canvas）共用同一套 JSON 节点模型。互动故事是存在磁盘上的节点图。 每种工作区都附带 `AGENTS.md` 和 JSON Schema，所以 Agent 编辑它们的方式和编辑代码一样， 可视化编辑器读写的也是同一批文件。 **3 · 游戏操作就是工具调用。** 试玩游戏（`game_use`）、生成媒体、检查故事节点， 都是普通的 Pi 工具，和它的编程工具放在一起。所以 Agent 能把它们串起来： 在一次对话里起草设计、制作美术、编写代码，再试玩结果。 ## 任意模型，自带密钥 OhMyGame 不会把你绑定在某一个模型上，也不按次收费。 - **40 多家服务商的编程模型**，通过 Pi 接入，包括 Anthropic、OpenAI、Google、DeepSeek、 通义千问（Qwen）、Kimi、智谱 GLM、MiniMax、xAI、Mistral、Groq、OpenRouter、 Amazon Bedrock 和 Vercel AI Gateway。 - **直接登录你已有的订阅**，例如 ChatGPT Plus/Pro 或 GitHub Copilot，也可以粘贴 API 密钥。 - **你已经在用的编程智能体**：Claude Code、Codex 和 OpenCode 使用各自的登录来运行对话， 对话记录、撤销、画布、媒体工具和插件仍由 OhMyGame 提供。在设置中启用，并遵循原生 CLI 的权限边界。详见[编程智能体](docs/coding-agents.md)。 - **媒体模型**：图片、视频、3D 和音频生成，可通过 OpenAI、Codex、OpenRouter、 火山方舟 / BytePlus ModelArk、MiniMax、Meshy、Tripo、Hyper3D，以及豆包语音 / Seed Audio 接入。 - **自定义服务商和模型别名**：可以选择语言、图片、视频和 3D 用途，配置协议模板和生成默认值。 详见[自定义模型配置](docs/custom-models.md)。 密钥只保存在本地守护进程里，永远不会进入 Agent 的工作区、你的游戏或渲染进程。 ## 快速开始 ### 下载 点击页面顶部的按钮，或者前往 [Releases](https://github.com/WhiteTowerAI/ohmygame/releases) 下载安装包。目前提供 macOS（Apple 芯片）和 Windows（x64）版本。Windows 版暂时还没有代码签名， 安装时 Windows 可能会弹出 SmartScreen 警告。 每个版本的变化可查看[更新日志](CHANGELOG.md)，或在应用内打开 **设置 → 关于 → 更新日志**。 ### 首次运行 ![首次运行 AI 连接页](docs/assets/first-run-onboarding.png) OhMyGame 不内置模型。首次启动时，它会带你完成设置： 1. **开始使用。** 语言和外观跟随系统，可随时在设置中更改。 2. **选择你的 AI。** 使用内置的 OhMyGame 智能体并连接模型服务商（登录或粘贴 API 密钥）， 也可以使用你已安装的 Claude Code、Codex 或 OpenCode CLI。点击 **+** 可添加自定义或本地接口。**跳过这一步** 可以先不连接模型。 只用语言模型也能设计和搭建游戏，生成媒体需要在 **设置 → 服务商** 中另外连接相应服务商： | 想做的东西 | 需要连接 | | ----------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------- | | 设计文档、代码、试玩 | 任意语言模型服务商 | | 图片和精灵图 | Codex CLI（本机登录）、OpenAI（API 密钥）、OpenRouter，或火山方舟 / BytePlus ModelArk | | 视频 | OpenRouter、火山方舟 / BytePlus ModelArk，或 MiniMax | | 3D 模型、骨骼绑定、动画 | Meshy、Tripo 或 Hyper3D（各服务商支持的能力不同） | | 配音、音效、音乐 | 豆包语音和 Seed Audio（火山引擎） | ChatGPT 登录不包含 OpenAI 的图片 API，需要在 OpenAI 服务商的 **图片模型** 区域另外添加 API 密钥。**Codex CLI** 图片服务商则使用本机的 Codex 登录。详见 [OpenAI image connections](docs/custom-models.md#openai-image-connections)。 3. **选择起点：** 在首页输入框里描述一个游戏、新建空白项目，或导入你已有的文件夹。 网页搜索无需配置即可使用。在本地做游戏不需要账号，只有发布时才需要登录。 可在 **设置 → 关于 → 查看入门引导** 中重新打开引导。 ### 从源码运行 工具链需要 Bun 1.4.2 或更高版本，守护进程需要 Node.js 22.19 及以上。 ```bash git clone --branch main https://github.com/WhiteTowerAI/ohmygame.git cd ohmygame bun install --frozen-lockfile bun run dev # 网页渲染端 + 本地守护进程 # 或者 bun run dev:desktop # Electron 桌面应用 ``` 这里用的是发布分支。如果要参与开发，请按照 [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md#fork-and-create-a-branch) 从 `dev` 分支开始。本地开发不需要任何云端配置即可启动；可选的集成配置见 [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md#configuration)。 ## 隐私 你的项目和密钥都留在你自己的电脑上。提示词和生成请求直接发送给你选择的模型服务商。 发布游戏需要 OhMyGame 账号，并且只上传游戏的静态构建产物。正式版会检查更新， 并发送使用数据和崩溃报告。登录后，使用数据会关联到你的账号，你可以在 **设置 → 关于** 中关闭。 从源码构建的版本不发送任何遥测数据。 桌面应用会在本机保留已脱敏的日志，只有当你在 **设置 → 关于 → 诊断信息** 中导出并分享文件时， 日志才会离开你的电脑。详见[日志与诊断](docs/diagnostics.md)。 ## 路线图 我们正在做通俗易懂的试玩报告、从社区 Remix 游戏，以及 Intel Mac / Linux 版本。 接下来的计划见 [Issues](https://github.com/WhiteTowerAI/ohmygame/issues)， 你可以给关心的功能点 👍 投票。想参与的话，可以看看标有 [`help wanted`](https://github.com/WhiteTowerAI/ohmygame/labels/help%20wanted) 的 Issue。 ## 参与贡献 欢迎提交 Issue 和 PR。贡献分支请从 `dev` 拉出，普通 PR 也提交到 `dev`；`main` 用于发布。 环境搭建、检查和评审流程见 [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)， 中文简介见[中文快速指引](docs/contributing.zh-CN.md)，各模块的说明见[文档索引](docs/README.md)。 安全问题请按照 [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) 报告。 ##
